notes.title: Early Access Update 1
notes.notes: [p]Thank you so much to players and content creators that already tried out the game! There are some really entertaining videos out there that show a glimpse of how fun the game could be once players get the hang of it. However, we also saw streams from content creators that did not have a good first time experience with the game. It's stressful to watch but very insightful. I'll discuss the major issues we noticed and how we addressed them over the past few days.[/p][h3][b]Controller Issues[/b][/h3][p]As noted on our page, we only have partial controller support right now as we didn't have the time to fully implement by launch. We were expecting most players would use keyboard and mouse for now. Unfortunately, there were significant features missing when using controller support so those that used one were likely to have a worse experience. We've fixed the following issues:[/p][list][*][p][FIXED] When using a controller, tooltips are not visible on Lobby Settings, Vending Machine and Inventory.[/p][/*][*][p][IMPROVEMENT] You can now toggle through player voting panels during discussion to see tooltips on top important icons (Cursed, Bonds, Secret GIfts, Conspire and Betray)[/p][/*][*][p][IMPROVEMENT] In Vending Machine, active button switches to buy after selecting an Advantage to improve usage.[/p][/*][/list][p]We're very close to having full controller support. Hopefully in a week or two.[/p][h3][b]Overwhelming First Play[/b][/h3][p]This is the biggest problem the game had on launch. When we were creating tutorials and explanations for the various mini games in the game, we decided to limit them to 15 seconds max, so that they don't prolong a full game duration too much. It's important for the game to have a brisk pace because eliminated players may get bored if the game gets too long. We also wanted to use as few words as possible for the tutorials because plenty of players skip lengthy explanations.[/p][p]Unfortunately, this caused lobbies of completely new players to get introduced to many different mini games in quick succession. And due to the vague tutorials, many players and viewers felt confused or overwhelmed.[/p][p]We implemented the following changes to improve new player experience:[/p][list][*][p][UPDATE] Secret Gifts will no longer be part of the default settings of the game. Host must toggle this in Lobby Settings to enable it.[/p][list][*][p]The Secret Gifts mini game is meant to give players an additional consideration when choosing who to vote for. When you give out a Curse or a Bond, you ideally want to keep those targets for as long as possible because you're earning money each round they survive. And when you receive a Curse, you have to figure out who gave it to you and vote them out asap to remove that drain on your pennies. This ideally prevents a predictable first vote that only targets the winners of [b]Let Them Eat Cake[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Because there are way too many new things to learn on the first game, most players barely factor Curses and Bonds anyway. So I believe it's a better experience for players to learn the base structure of the game first, and then enable this on second or third play once players are already familiar with the core loop.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][IMPROVEMENT] Extended tutorials up to 30 seconds. [u]To speed up later games, Lobby Host can skip tutorial.[/u][/p][/*][*][p][IMPROVEMENT] Improved tutorials for [b]Let Them Eat Cake[/b], [b]Secret Gifts[/b], [b]Conspire or Betray[/b] and [b]Pay or Bluff[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][IMPROVEMENT] Rephrased Round Intro voice overs to provide players with clearer explanations of what to expect per round.[/p][/*][*][p][IMPROVEMENT] Added an instruction on the Vending Machine phase to give hints on what players can do there.[/p][/*][*][p][IMPROVEMENT] Extended Secret GIft Results duration to 20 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p][IMPROVEMENT] Extended first round Vending Machine phase to 45 seconds to give players more time to talk privately and learn about advantages.[/p][/*][*][p][IMPROVEMENT] Extended default first round discussion phase to 45 seconds to further slow down the pace of the first round.[/p][/*][*][p][IMPROVEMENT] Rephrased tooltips for each type of Secret Gift to make their effects clearer.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Boring Defector Gameplay[/b][/h3][p]We already know that simply breaking crates to earn Pennies is a pretty boring task but it was pretty far down the list of things we want to improve by Early Access launch. Unfortunately, this proved to be a mistake because there were players that really really hated it. Our fixes:[/p][list][*][p][IMPROVEMENT] Sped up Defector attack animation and increased their attack range. This should make breaking crates less frustrating.[/p][/*][*][p][UPDATE] Defectors will now be able to enter circus tents to play a variety of mini games. These are the same mini games that players encounter during Hoarding. They'll earn Pennies based on performance.[/p][/*][/list][p]The Temptation Shop is a deceptively simple feature. Initially, new Defectors tend to offer these too quickly and randomly. But as players become more familiar with the game, I expect they will also develop smarter strategies on how to use their offers to affect the direction of the game, either in an attempt to win, or just punish those that voted them out. We actually see this start to show up now on lobbies of players that already playtested the game before launch.[/p][h3][b]Repetitive[/b][/h3][p]As a social deception game, it's important to emphasize that the true focus of gameplay in Eat the Rich is in the social elements and use of advantages during the vote discussion. For us, the mini games have a similar level of importance to tasks in Among Us. It was intentional that these are mostly quick, simple and familiar because we want them to enhance voting conversations without prolonging a full game too much.[/p][p]In Among Us, tasks spread the players out all over the map, and then players can bring that up in meetings to figure out who the impostors are. Yes, the tasks are pretty simple and mindless, but it works because Among Us is all about what happens during meetings. In Eat The Rich, brawl and mind games are mainly meant to change the wealth of players, and also to cause "friendships" and "rivalries" to form. These will then factor into who players choose to vote out.[/p][p][b]We are of course still planning to[/b] [b]introduce more brawl games and mind games[/b] over the course of the next months. These just take a while longer to complete since each mini game is practically an entire new small game. [u]But to set expectation, these will all be fairly quick and simple as well.[/u][/p][h3][b]Other Bug Fixes and Tweaks[/b][/h3][list][*][p][IMPROVEMENT] Ensured that at least one different brawl mini game will be chosen on consecutive plays.[/p][/*][*][p][IMPROVEMENT] Tooltips still show on Sold advantages in Vending Machines.[/p][/*][*][p][IMPROVEMENT] All Advantages are now usable while in Vending Machine phase.[/p][/*][*][p][IMPROVEMENT] Added 3 extra seconds to the Elimination Cutscene duration when a Scapegoat was used. Previous duration is too fast to read and understand what happened, especially if multiple Scapegoats were used.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][FIXED] When a body accessory is unlocked, game displays a pants cosmetic instead.[/p][/*][*][p][FIXED] Victory Cutscene nameplate misaligned if player name is too long.[/p][/*][*][p][FIXED] Player Spotlights scene just shows static video on reconnect.[/p][/*][*][p][FIXED] Player Spotlights wrong text if there are only 2 players included in Player Spotlights.[/p][/*][*][p][FIXED] Bots may get stuck during Let Them Eat Cake.[/p][/*][*][p][FIXED] In Let Them Eat Cake, plate assets from previous game may show up in the next.[/p][/*][*][p][FIXED] In Problem Solver, players can no longer pick up letter cubes when the terminal is already checking the answer.[/p][/*][*][p][UPDATE] Removed Formal Alliance settings. Context: It's an inferior version of the game that unnecessarily limits voting options.[/p][/*][*][p][BALANCE] Reduced interest earned from Investment.[/p][/*][/list][p]As always, we are open to feedback and suggestions.[/p][p][b]Maccima Games Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: DevLog #3: 2025 Roadmap
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone! We just launched the game on Early Access. Thank you so much to everyone who already purchased the game this early! We likely won't have a big enough player base yet for you to be able to consistently play public random lobbies quickly. Please bear with us! We recommend playing private games with friends for now as we build up our audience throughout our Early Access phase.[/p][p][/p][p]We'd like to mention a few more small things we just added to the game that weren't discussed in previous DevLogs:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Emotes[/b][/p][p]Players can now emote in the game! There are a total of 8 emotes to choose from.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849523/5b55503c77636a73df65e609ca51f24e5d3e8558.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]Cosmetic Unlocks[/b][/h3][p]Most of the character customization options are locked when you first play. Players unlock them by playing a full game. The higher the player's rank, the more cosmetics they will unlock.[/p][list][*][p]Winner - 5 Skins[/p][/*][*][p]Runner Up - 3 Skins[/p][/*][*][p]Other Finalists - 2 Skins[/p][/*][*][p]Losers - 1 Skin[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849523/a6a66e10ea0b6a9558aed5718314f3f56cb88620.png"][/img][/p][p]Of course this is just the start. While the Early Access version is a complete experience, it needs some more mini games, advantages and tweaks before we can confidently advance it to v1.0. We'd like to give you a preview of what's in store for the rest of the year.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Update 1 - Mid October[/b][/h3][p]This is a a relatively small update as we expect to spend the next few weeks assessing player feedback and addressing critical bugs and tweaks.[/p][p][b]Bot enmity system[/b][/p][p]This is a set of various features to make our player bots appear smarter and react to players more rationally. In essence, bots will keep track of player actions for and against them. They are more likely to vote out or use items on players who are hostile to them. For example, using Betray against a bot will make them more likely to vote you out.[/p][p][b]Updated HUD[/b][/p][p]For our next update, we want to reduce the space occupied by our main HUD. Here's a mockup:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849523/4b5088d75eb2885d9ee53e3afb45bb689a5274c6.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Volume settings[/b][/p][p]We planned on having this on our Early Access launch but didn't have the time to finish it. This will allow players to adjust the volume of individual players.[/p][p][b]Bug fixes and tweaks[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Update 2 - Mid November[/b][/h3][p]This will be our first content update. We'll introduce 2 new advantages and another brawl minigame.[/p][p][b]New Advantages[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Timeout[/i] - This is a troll item that will secretly mute another player for 30 seconds. They can still talk and chat but other players will not be able to hear or read it! They will only be notified that they are on Timeout after it expires![/p][/*][*][p][i]Intel[/i] - This is a powerful item that will allow you to inspect another player. You'll see their inventory, status effects (Amnesty, etc), accepted Defector offers as well as who they gifted their Curses and Bonds to.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New Minigame[/b][/p][p]Our first post early access launch brawl game will be a simple rhythm-type minigame titled [b]Gluttony[/b]![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Update 3 - Mid December[/b][/h3][p]This is a major content update! December is typically a great month for party games so we hope at this point, Eat the Rich will have enough content to be a great option for friend groups to incorporate in their variety of party games.[/p][p][b]3 new minigames[/b][/p][p]The plan is to introduce 2 new brawl games (likely titled [b]Kiss Cam[/b] and [b]Where's Luigi?[/b]) and 1 new mind game. We'll let you know more about these soon![/p][p][b]Achievements[/b][/p][p]We plan to have around 15 Achievements for Eat the Rich. Players will also be rewarded with unique cosmetics for unlocking these![/p][p][b]New cosmetics[/b][/p][p]In addition to cosmetics unlocked through Achievements, we'll also have some more new cosmetics to unlock by playing/winning the game.[/p][p][b]Twitch integration[/b][/p][p]We're exploring ways to improve Content Creator experience with the game. We're currently studying what types of Twitch integrations we could include to make the game more engaging for Twitch streamers and their viewers. Please let us know if you have suggestions![/p][p][/p][p]We're hopeful that by year end, the game would have more content and a bunch of new mini-games for a fresh update![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you and we hope you enjoy voting out your rich friends![/p][p][b]Maccima Games Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: DevLog #2
notes.notes: [p]Hello, everyone! We're happy to share that Eat the Rich is part of the Tiny Teams festival! Perfect time to share another development update.[/p][h3]Brawl Game: Corporate Rivals[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849523/bf5b90a25cf1989495413c63a462d4dfc4a78141.png"][/img][/p][p]This is a new Brawl Game that will also be available once we launch Early Access. Alliances race to earn 10 points. Teams take turns opening briefcases. There are 5 different types of briefcases:[/p][list][*][p]SELF - increases or decreases points of the current player's alliance[/p][/*][*][p]OTHERS - increases or decreases points of all alliances except the current player's[/p][/*][*][p]ALL - increases or decreases points of all alliances[/p][/*][*][p]FIRST - increases or decreases points of the alliance with the most points[/p][/*][*][p]LAST - increases or decreases points of the alliance with the least points[/p][/*][/list][h3]Advantage Update: Investment[/h3][p]In its previous state, the Investment advantage instantly takes half of the player's current pennies and only returns it plus a whopping +50% when the player reaches the finale. It is a powerful tool that both increases the player's final Pennies and also likely hides them from getting highlighted during Player Spotlights. [/p][p]We've decided to slightly nerf it by adjusting the amount of interest it adds at the finale based on when you used it. If used on the first round, it still adds 50% interest, but if it's used on the last round, it will now only add 20% interest.[/p][p]You will now also be able to keep track of how much will be returned to you on the Round Summary:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849523/8769c877e8a5de172ed6eccc2ac15244f2c01894.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Streamlined Voting Phase[/h3][p]This is a significant tweak that should simplify and improve the experience of first time players.[/p][p]For our Vote Out phase during the demo, we return the players to the Circus map and give them a few minutes to roam around and connive secretly with other players via proximity chat. There are also 3 Vending Machines in the map where Advantages can be purchased. We added this phase to allow players to execute big-brained schemes. We imagine devious players juggling multiple alliances and then carrying out shocking betrayals.[/p][p]Unfortunately, this isn't what actually happens. Because we want full game sessions to take 20 to 30 mins max, we can't really give players more than a couple of minutes on this phase. The end result is that this phase devolves into a mad rush towards the Vending Machines and just a few quick chats to whoever you randomly encounter there.[/p][p]Now, after a Mind Game ends, the players stay for a bit inside their private tents. Each private tent will have their own Vending Machines, so players still have a few moments to purchase advantages, as well as discuss secret plans (or argue) with their Mind Games "partners". [b]When the Vote Out phase starts, the players will go straight to the Voting Interface. Before actual voting is enabled, there will be a configurable set of time that they can discuss in full public who to vote, use advantages, or get offered Defector temptations.[/b][/p][p]This change shaves off about half a minute per round, and lessens what new players must learn to do.[/p][p][/p][h3]Various Visual Polish[/h3][p]Take a look at some small but cool visual improvements we recently added.[/p][p][b]Game Lobby[/b][/p][p]Our Game Lobby is now getting close to the level of polish that we aim to apply to the entire game if we have the perfect budget, time and experience. Unfortunately, we are way more limited with what we can do for now but we hope to keep improving other aspects of the game, albeit slowly.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849523/fcaa19d008ed8f8c9b83006a1f6497ce18976b90.gif"][/img][b]Dash[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849523/f043accff4a9ee6b50d2f19de820be6fa211dc4e.gif"][/img][/p][h3]Secondary Title[/h3][p]We just recently were made aware that Free Lives (creators of Broforce, Gorn, Terra Nil, etc) has a Black Friday Simulator game that's also called Eat the RIch on itch.io. In order to avoid market confusion, we have agreed to include a secondary title for our own Eat the Rich game.[/p][p]Welcome to [b]Eat the Rich: Greed Games[/b]. We'll be updating our Steam title and marketing assets asap.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849523/0a15e5b00f39a1009510de7096b6edde7549f8bb.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Devlog #1: Early Access Launch Update
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone! It has been a few weeks since we participated in Steam's Next Fest. We were both excited and nervous to finally see the game played by regular players as well as streamers.[/p][p][/p][p]We were glad to see players having fun with the chaos and betrayal aspects of the game but we also noticed that first time experience can get overwhelming for some. Right now it takes about 2 or 3 full games before some players fully understand it. [/p][p][/p][p]I think that's fairly normal for a new game with some novel mechanics like Eat the Rich. But, before launching on Early Access, we want to ensure that new players can have a lot of fun even while they are still learning the game on their first session. We now realize that we still need to improve many aspects of our visuals, on-boarding UX and tutorials to achieve this. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Launch Delayed to September 10[/b][/h3][p]Unfortunately, with these tweaks that means we have to delay our Early Access launch.[b] We've decided to move the launch date to September 10. [/b]This should give us more time to polish existing content, and add some more mini games for you to enjoy with your frenemies when we launch.[/p][p][/p][p]For now, here's a sneak peek at what we're currently working on this month.[/p][h3][b]New Brawl Game[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849523/9b1566d53a37641b7ad70f7c24b29280f99de102.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We can't have a party game called Eat the Rich without a cooking mini game! The title is [b]Let Them Eat Cake[/b] - allegedly said by Marie Antoinette when she heard that peasants are starving. Here, the rich will be serving these delicious cakes to the peasants. This is a team-based competitive variant of typical cooking games like Overcooked and Plate Up.[/p][p]We're still trying out different setups. We could allow combat, but it has the risk of making the mini game too chaotic and frustrating. But without combat, it will be a very straightforward time-management competition between the teams.[/p][p]Either way, this is likely going to be a special mini game that will only be played on the first round. It takes much longer to finish than the others, and works best when everyone is still in the game.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Voting UI[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849523/113c90a39132ef18ba5526fe3f93deaa543b9927.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We've completely revamped our Voting Interface. This is where players vote to eliminate a player out of the game. We're making it full screen and updating its assets to align with our Player Spotlights Interface.[/p][p]Normally, players should try to vote out who they think the richest player is, but there are also other factors that more experienced players should take into consideration:[/p][list][*][p]In the first round, players anonymously gift Curses and Bonds to other players. Curses allow you to steal pennies at the end of each round, while Bond makes both gifter and receiver earn pennies. These incentivizes the gifter to keep those players alive for as long as possible, even if they are already richer. It might be hard to keep track of your gifted Curse and Bond so we're adding icons for these in the Voting Interface.[/p][/*][*][p]Some rounds, players will play a Mind Game called Conspire or Betray. This is a Prisoner's Dilemma-type game where players place bets and then picks either Conspire, or Betray. If everyone picks Conspire, they need to protect each other from elimination to earn pennies equal to the amount they bet. If it's a mix of Conspires and Betrays, the betrayers will get pennies from those who conspired, as well as an extra Advantage! But if it's all Betrays, everyone loses a LOT of pennies. We're also adding icons in the Voting Interface to remind players who conspired and betrayed them that round.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Walking Heads[/b][/h3][p]Depending on the number of players, the game could last either 4 or 5 rounds. The first two eliminated players become Defectors so they still have something to do even after getting eliminated. Players eliminated after the second round simply become spectators. Depending on the timers set by the host, they may end up watching and waiting too long before they can play again.[/p][p]To improve on this, we're turning eliminated players who don't become Defectors into "Walking Heads"! While there's no opportunity to win anymore, they can now move around the map and do various activities:[/p][list][*][p]During Vote Out phase, they can text chat with nearby active players and teleport to the Defector Room to talk to the Defectors.[/p][/*][*][p]Visit the defector room and spectate active players via the Temptation Shop (although they can't offer temptations since they are not Defectors).[/p][/*][*][p]Annoy active players by playing different emotes.[/p][/*][*][p]During Brawl Games, they are now also moving penny pinatas! They drop pennies if they get punched by active players and defectors. They can also be picked up by active players and thrown at other players like an explosive device![/p][/*][/list][p]Watch out for bullies![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849523/9c746ac5e5c1f4a0a598b2a16ed2c8a851eac5e2.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]There are a few other fun tweaks we're working on that we'll share on our next Devlog. Please stay tuned![/p][p][b]Maccima Games[/b][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update | New Minigames: Crypto Miners and Pay or Bluff!
notes.notes: [p]We've just released a new update for the demo to give you something new to try![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849523/8080c1894af50898a051615082c686f27f74d306.png"][/img][/p][p]What's new:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849523/d688b0114c75c4bb272530d4e9b2246863e2c962.gif"][/img][/p][h1]NEW Mini-game: Crypto Miners[/h1][p]Help speed up global warming by mining imaginary coins! Work with your allies to make sure you've got the most totally-real money in your wallet.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849523/471624344f73aaecb758b5ed53b71a769298bd31.gif"][/img][/p][h1]NEW Mini-game: Pay or Bluff[/h1][p]Kick it old school with good ol' gambling! Pay the pool or bluff on your turn, and pick the right moment to call someone's bluff to win everything on the table![/p][p][/p][p]We've also squashed some bugs and added Smart Bots to fill your matches. We hope to improve their behavior as development goes on![/p][p][/p][h1]Eat the Rich Releasing on July 23[/h1][p][/p][previewyoutube="xqeCwG4gu2k;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Our game is coming to Steam on July 23, and we've been overwhelmed by the support in the past week, thanks to the [b]Southeast Asian Games Showcase [/b]and [b]The MIX Summer Showcase[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]Our new demo is live as part of Summer Game Fest and run all the way through [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]! After that, we'll be heads down focusing on the release so give Eat the Rich a go while the demo is still available![/p][p][/p][p]-Eat the Rich Team[/p]

notes.title: Demo Out Now!
notes.notes:
[h1]Eat the Rich Demo Out Now![/h1]

Society has collapsed due to the unbridled greed of the 1%. In retribution (and in lieu of a guillotine), the masses have forced the billionaires responsible into a deadly carnivalesque game show against each other called EAT THE RICH.

Get a taste of what's to come to your favorite demented game show! Play our demo now!

[h3]This Demo includes the following features:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849523/d0e1f52affd10c9a0b11767ce5d29501cb227e88.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Full game flow featuring Group Mini-games, Solo Brawls and Solo Mini-games, Voting and Elimination.
[*] 30+ customizable items to dress for the silver screen!
[*] 10+ Advantage items to help you secure your win, no matter what democracy says!
[*] 6 mini-games to play with and against your friends!
[/list]

[h3]More to Come![/h3]

Our team is hard at work making sure that there's tons of mini-games to do with your friends AND enemies. We're hoping add in more features like:
[list]
[*]More language translations--EVERYONE should Eat the Rich!
[*]Brand new advantages to help spice up the game!
[*]Seasonal skin packs to make sure you're dressed to the nines for your reckoning!
[*]And, even more mini-games to release your frustrations on the 1% on!
[/list]
